notes.title: Massive Update: Graphics, Gameplay & Enhanced Content!
notes.notes:
🎨 Graphics & Atmosphere
Completely reworked cats, enemies, and environments

New visual effects for attacks, artifacts, and environments

10 different, more immersive and stylish environments
🛠️ Redesigned gameplay
The Wheel spins endlessly: improve damage, speed, earn diamonds, and more.

Place up to 3 cats in battle.

Each cat has a unique attack to target specific enemies.
💎 Economy & progression
Cats can be purchased with Purple Orbs (from bosses, resale of cats, or exchanged for diamonds)

30 playable cats, each fully upgradeable

30 enemy types and 10 bosses, unlocked throughout the game
🗝️ Artifacts & Strategy
Artifacts to obtain: very rare on enemies, more common on bosses.

They offer bonuses: increased attack, attack speed, extra cat, and more.

Think about your combos: cat + artifact = optimized build.

This update greatly enriches the experience: more control, strategy, and visual and playful challenges. 👉 The bosses from the trailer are here, and more will be added gradually.

Thank you for your feedback and support! Join me on Discord to discuss it.
